description: This file contains implementation code for container management within the WPEFramework, including classes and methods for container lifecycle operations such as creation, starting, stopping, and status checks, as well as singleton access patterns and logging initialization.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages container instances, providing methods to create and insert containers based on configuration files.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status, as well as manage container arguments and cleanup.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the container administrator.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on configuration files found in specified search paths.

methods.name: CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes container context and logging.

methods.name: ~CRunContainer
methods.description: Destructor that stops the container if running and removes it from the administrator.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of the container.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container (not implemented, returns nullptr).

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Replaces the container's process arguments with new command and parameters.

methods.name: ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Removes leftover containers that may exist from previous runs.
